## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
- DD1: Define enum vocabulary for cross_reviewer_agreement (4 values): UNANIMOUS, MAJORITY, SPLIT, SINGLE_REVIEWER
- DD2: Define enum vocabulary for cross_cycle_pattern (7 values): NEW_INTRODUCED, RECURRING, RESUSTAIN_OF, RESOLVED_THEN_REINTRODUCED, ESCALATED, DEFENDED_PRIOR_CYCLE, UNKNOWN
- DD3: Define enum vocabulary for impact_class (8 values): bug, unintended_behavior, security_vulnerability, data_loss_or_corruption, secret_exposure, compliance_violation, api_contract_break, infrastructure_break + 'none' (non-floor)
- DD4: Update code-reviewer-arbiter.md agent prompt with the enums + computation guidance
- DD9 (partial): contracts/review-defenses.md arbiter sub-schema updated with new fields + schema_version 1.1.0

## TDD Requirement
Doc-only — test exempt per behavioral-testing-standard Rule 5 (LLM instruction file). Structural verification via grep ACs.

## Implementation Notes

1. Edit `plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md` Mandatory Output Schema section. Add three new fields:
   ```
   - cross_reviewer_agreement: array of strings, each from {UNANIMOUS, MAJORITY, SPLIT, SINGLE_REVIEWER}
   - cross_cycle_pattern: array of strings, each from {NEW_INTRODUCED, RECURRING, RESUSTAIN_OF, RESOLVED_THEN_REINTRODUCED, ESCALATED, DEFENDED_PRIOR_CYCLE, UNKNOWN}
   - impact_class: exactly one of {bug, unintended_behavior, security_vulnerability, data_loss_or_corruption, secret_exposure, compliance_violation, api_contract_break, infrastructure_break, none}
   ```
2. Add "Enum Vocabularies" subsection documenting each value's meaning (1-line per value).
3. Add to BLOCK-Gate AND-Logic: condition 4 — impact_class ∈ 8-category floor (i.e., NOT 'none'). BLOCK requires ALL FOUR conditions.
4. Update Anti-Compromise Rules to include enum vocabulary enforcement.
5. Update `plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md` arbiter_ruling sub-schema: add cross_reviewer_agreement, cross_cycle_pattern, impact_class fields with enum descriptions. Bump schema_version 1.0.0 → 1.1.0. Change Log entry.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] code-reviewer-arbiter.md contains all 4 cross_reviewer_agreement enum values
  Verify: for v in UNANIMOUS MAJORITY SPLIT SINGLE_REVIEWER; do grep -q "\$v" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] code-reviewer-arbiter.md contains all 7 cross_cycle_pattern enum values
  Verify: for v in NEW_INTRODUCED RECURRING RESUSTAIN_OF RESOLVED_THEN_REINTRODUCED ESCALATED DEFENDED_PRIOR_CYCLE UNKNOWN; do grep -q "\$v" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] code-reviewer-arbiter.md contains all 8 impact_class floor values
  Verify: for v in bug unintended_behavior security_vulnerability data_loss_or_corruption secret_exposure compliance_violation api_contract_break infrastructure_break; do grep -q "\$v" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md || exit 1; done
- [ ] BLOCK-Gate AND-Logic mentions impact_class floor
  Verify: grep -i "impact_class.*floor\|floor.*impact_class" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/agents/code-reviewer-arbiter.md
- [ ] contracts/review-defenses.md schema_version is 1.1.0
  Verify: grep -E "schema_version.*1\.1\.0" \$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/plugins/dso/docs/contracts/review-defenses.md

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
data.title: Define enum vocabularies in code-reviewer-arbiter.md + contracts/review-defenses.md (4-val cross_reviewer_agreement, 7-val cross_cycle_pattern, 8-val impact_class floor)
